value.text: {"result": {"suggestions": [{"kind": "existing_thesis", "pillar_id": "GOOGL.p3", "stance": "supports", "strength": 2, "wrong_if_met": false, "assumptions": [], "rationale": "A final EU non-compliance decision with a fine and a required removal or redesign of vertical search units in the EEA is a regulatory remedy in search that restricts distribution, which is what the pillar describes, and it is not narrow or delayed.", "claim_ids": ["synthetic_000081.c1", "synthetic_000081.c2", "synthetic_000081.c3", "synthetic_000081.c4"], "sections": [{"email_id": "synthetic_000081", "quote": "The European Commission adopted its final non-compliance decision on search self-preferencing under the Digital Markets Act yesterday."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000081", "quote": "Fine of EUR 2.9bn (about $3.4bn), non-deductible."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000081", "quote": "Google must remove or fundamentally redesign vertical search units (shopping, hotels, flights, local) in EEA results."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000081", "quote": "2027E Search revenue: -$1.6bn to $243.4bn (-0.7%); about 1.2% below consensus"}]}], "no_change_reason": null}}
